summary.text: Karen DeSanto is a Democratic member of the Wisconsin State Assembly from District 40 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election against Republican Julie Helmer.
She previously was CEO of the Boys & Girls Clubs of West Central Wisconsin.

paragraphs.text: Karen DeSanto's career experience includes working as CEO of the Boys & Girls Clubs of West Central Wisconsin, and she has served as president of the State Alliance of Wisconsin Clubs.
She defeated Jerry Helmer in the November 5, 2024 general election for Assembly District 40.
For 2025-2026 she is assigned to the Mental Health Committee and the Rural Development Committee.
